== Strategy ==

I took out Sim Aloo, Snoova and his vibro ax to add 2 I have you nows, and another after her

The whole deck is based around getting as many destinies as possible and adding to the destinies.

Emperors power adds a destiny

Grand admiral thrawn on chimaera is 2 destinies

P-60/P-59 are 2 destinies

Moment of triumph adds a destiny with a lone alien(jade or sing), and 2 if tarkin( 3 if you  also use emperors power)

Maul strikes adds 1 or two destinies if lord maul vs Qui-Gon 3 destinies +3

Vaders cape and darth vader add one to each destiny,

The Stormtrooper garrison adds a destiny with vader, tarkin, the emperor or even thrawn-for 10 u get power ten and 2 destinies 3 with emps power, so even if the chimaera is lost

He  still is worth having

After her adds one to each destiny, and if u wipe out the opponent you retrieve 4 force and put a destiny 5 back in the deck

I have you now works with palpatine, sidious,  the 4 vaders and the 3 mauls to add a desiny or if vader cant get to luke beat down on luke with an extra 2 destinies, making it so they cant just keep redeploying luke if vaders compromised

Prepared defenses adds one to a destiny

Colo claw fish lets you cycle out the lowest destiny,or save a realy high weapon destiny,

and tarkin still lets you cancel an oponents destiny if with vader

with 3 sevens, if you didnt lose any(remember the phantom menace goes back if maul is lost)gives you reasonable odds of turning Luke with only 2 on insignificant rebellion

if the emperor is lost you can usually get him back with imperial reinforcements

always take death star II docking bay on first turn with arrest order

Destiny

0-4

1-19

2-2

3-5

4-8

5-9

6-1

7-3

I know it seems like a lot of low destinies, but remember you’ll usually get three of them so at least one should be good, and u have 6 cards that add to destiny

Thanx for helping me the first time, I’d still appreciate any more comments or suggestions
